description: A stereo performance filter on one knob, sweeping from a low pass up through an untouched centre into a high pass

params.text: Sets the filter: fully anticlockwise gives a 20Hz low pass, the centre passes everything, fully clockwise gives a 20000Hz high pass
Adds resonance around the cutoff, raising the filter Q from 0.707 to 4.707
Held down, it runs the SWEEP knob itself back to centre over about a third of a second

inputs.text: Offsets the SWEEP knob, 10V covering its full travel
Offsets the RES knob, 10V covering its full travel
Above 1V it runs the SWEEP knob itself back to centre over about a third of a second
The right audio input; it follows the left input when unpatched

outputs.text: The left output, the filtered signal crossfaded against the input near the centre position
The right output, the filtered signal crossfaded against the input near the centre position

notes: within 3% of the centre position the filter is faded out entirely, so the knob passes through a true bypass instead of clicking
the reset button and its CV input move the SWEEP knob itself, so the knob is seen to travel and any automation written to it is overwritten

inputs.0:
0 to 10V · continuous · one channel only

a negative voltage subtracts from the knob; the knob and this input are summed and the total held to 0 to 10V.
inputs.1:
0 to 10V · continuous · one channel only

a negative voltage subtracts from the knob; the knob and this input are summed and the total held to 0 to 10V.
inputs.2:
high above 1V · stepped · one channel only

a negative voltage does nothing here.
inputs.4:
±5V · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads the left input.
